Russia to Ban Direct P2P Crypto Trades Starting July 2027

According to Cointelegraph, the Bank of Russia confirmed in updated guidance that direct peer-to-peer (P2P) cryptocurrency transactions between individuals will be banned starting July 1, 2027, requiring users to transact exclusively through authorized intermediaries. The central bank also clarified that individuals are prohibited from transferring crypto assets from regulated digital accounts to personal self-custody wallets. — link

Ledger Announces Android-Based Hardware Device "Atom" with Anti-Tamper Enclosure

According to CoinDesk, hardware wallet provider Ledger has unveiled "Atom," an Android-based device slated for launch in mid-2027 that integrates everyday smartphone applications with hardware-level crypto security. Designed to mitigate physical supply-chain tampering, Atom features a tamper-proof enclosure specifically engineered to block the screen-reader implants and physical hardware modifications observed in recent attacks. — link
